# QS-CFW-1159-60 - Quality specification - track link CFW-1159-60 (15B37)

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-1159-60

## Scope
This specification defines the quality requirements and inspection methods for track link CFW-1159-60 (CFW-1159-60) forgings produced at Plant P3. It applies to all production lots and any repair or reforge operations where the finished part is intended to meet the same service function as the original part.

## Requirements table

| Attribute | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---:|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for track link CFW-1159-60 (CFW-1159-60) is 36-40 HRC. | Material hardness within specified range across hardened area. |
| Bore diameter | The bore diameter tolerance for track link CFW-1159-60 (CFW-1159-60) is ±0.03 mm. | Bore measured along bore axis; deviation within tolerance. |
| Forging weight | The maximum forging weight for track link CFW-1159-60 (CFW-1159-60) is 80.0 kg. | Forging weight does not exceed stated maximum prior to finish machining. |

## Inspection method
Visual and dimensional inspection shall verify geometry and surface condition. Hardness shall be verified using a calibrated portable hardness tester applied to the hardened flank and bore relief areas; readings shall be taken and documented at representative locations and shall demonstrate conformance to the hardness requirement. Bore diameter shall be measured using calibrated bore gages or an equivalent method capable of demonstrating the stated tolerance. Forging weight shall be recorded on the heat lot travel document and compared to the maximum forging weight requirement prior to any machining.

Calibration status of inspection equipment must be traceable to the supplier calibration records. Inspection results shall be recorded on the lot inspection record and retained per plant document control requirements.

## Nonconformance handling
Parts failing any requirement shall be segregated and marked to prevent shipment. Root cause analysis shall be initiated and corrective actions defined. Disposition may include rework, reheat treatment, or scrap subject to engineering disposition and approval. Final disposition shall be documented on the lot inspection record before release.
